capabilities: write words with explanations in vocaview code blocks
preview words as a list, single-choice quiz, or card
randomly pick words and hide either the word or the explanation
add and remove words in configured vocabulary book files
extras: Spell checking was added in version 0.1.2 and Vocabulary Books in 0.1.3 per the update log; installation is described via manual file copying.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write vocabulary words with explanations and practice them in a quiz or flashcard-style view.
summary: Vocabulary study plugin that renders word-and-definition pairs written in code blocks as lists, multiple-choice quizzes, or flip cards.
